about: A small public sample for the live web check (backend/tests/live). The full list is kept privately and passed with SYNAPSE_LIVE_SITES.

sites.why: an ordinary docs page behind a CDN
a large page whose content is a table; the scraper keeps its first 50,000 characters, so its check is a row near the top
robots.txt disallows it: the knowledge fetch says so, and the harness fetches it with nothing else
an error that is not a block: a missing page must never read as anti-bot protection
